mapper.select: SELECT role,is_active FROM users WHERE id=#{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_profiles(user_id,student_no,major,grade,target_cohort) VALUES (#{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT},#{studentNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{major,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{grade,jdbcType=INTEGER},#{cohort,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET major=EXCLUDED.major,grade=EXCLUDED.grade,target_cohort=EXCLUDED.target_cohort,synced_at=now()
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM app_rag_requests WHERE session_id=#{sessionId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND state='running')

mapper.update: UPDATE rag_sessions SET archived=true,target_scope=target_scope||jsonb_build_object('deletedAt',now()),updated_at=now() WHERE user_id=#{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND id IN (#{id,jdbcType=BIGINT}) AND target_scope->>'deletedAt' IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rag_queries q JOIN rag_sessions s ON s.id=q.session_id WHERE q.id=#{queryId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND s.user_id=#{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND s.target_scope->>'deletedAt' IS NULL AND q.workflow_state='completed')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_rag_feedback(query_id,user_id,rating,comment) VALUES (#{queryId,jdbcType=BIGINT},#{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT},#{rating,jdbcType=INTEGER},#{comment,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ON CONFLICT(query_id,user_id) DO UPDATE SET rating=EXCLUDED.rating,comment=EXCLUDED.comment,updated_at=now()
mapper.select: SELECT metadata::text AS metadata,status FROM knowledge_docs WHERE id=#{docId,jdbcType=BIGINT} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_docs SET title=#{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR},version=#{version,jdbcType=VARCHAR},updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{docId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND status IN ('active','deprecated')
